primary_objective: Land the rocket at coordinates (0,0) safely with minimal time and fuel consumption.
objective_decomposition: Descent initiation: Orient lander towards pad and reduce altitude.
Alignment: Use side engines to correct angle to near zero.
Velocity damping: Reduce vertical velocity using main engine before touchdown.
Final touchdown: Ensure both legs contact ground simultaneously with low impact.
behavior_trajectory_alignment: Descent initiation: Orient lander towards pad and reduce altitude.
Alignment: Use side engines to correct angle to near zero.
Velocity damping: Reduce vertical velocity using main engine before touchdown.
Final touchdown: Ensure both legs contact ground simultaneously with low impact.
diagnostic_metrics: Landing success rate per episode batch
Crash frequency by cause (velocity vs position)
success_criteria: Position within pad bounds (abs(state[0]) < threshold, state[1] approx 0)
Low vertical velocity magnitude at contact
failure_modes: Hovering indefinitely to avoid crash penalty without landing
Oscillating near pad without committing to final descent
Intentional crashing for quick episode reset if negative reward is insufficient
bad_local_optima: Hovering indefinitely to avoid crash penalty without landing
Oscillating near pad without committing to final descent
Intentional crashing for quick episode reset if negative reward is insufficient
reward_generator_constraints: Separate sparse landing bonus from dense shaping for progress.
Use reachable progress feedback (distance/velocity) when success is hard to discover.
Keep fuel/time regularizers mild to avoid penalizing necessary correction maneuvers.
Track component scale interactions between velocity penalty and position reward.
